user.title: Connect to EEG GrünLicht
user.description: Open “App verbinden” in the member portal and enter the 8-character short code shown below the QR code.

reauth_confirm.title: Reconnect to EEG GrünLicht
reauth_confirm.description: The connection to the energy community was removed or has expired. Open “App verbinden” in the member portal and enter the new short code.

progress.wait_confirm:
Now confirm the new connection “Home Assistant” in the member portal. The portal must show this code:

**{pairing_code}**

You have 2 minutes. This window continues on its own.

error.invalid_format: The short code has 8 characters (letters and digits).
error.invalid_code: Short code invalid or expired. Reload the portal and try again.
error.too_many_attempts: Too many attempts. Please wait a few minutes.
error.cannot_connect: The energy community cannot be reached right now.

abort.already_configured: This member account is already connected.
abort.wrong_member: The short code belongs to a different member account.
abort.pairing_rejected: The connection was rejected in the portal.
abort.pairing_expired: Time for confirmation ran out. Start the setup again.
abort.pairing_denied: The energy community refused the connection. Start the setup again.

init.title: Permissions
init.description:
Choose which data flows between the energy community and Home Assistant. Every permission is voluntary and can be withdrawn at any time.

**Household profile (stage 3):** Purpose: {purpose}. Who may see it: {recipients}. Sent are device type, manufacturer, model, key figures and your supply contract details – no meter readings, no serial numbers. If you switch this off, the community deletes the data.

data.import_energy: Import the community's quarter-hour values into statistics (stage 2)
data.report_profile: Report the household profile to the community (stage 3)

devices.title: Devices
devices.description: Home Assistant detected {count} energy devices. Choose which ones to report and add what Home Assistant does not know. Empty fields are not sent.

supply.title: Electricity supply
supply.description: Who supplies the electricity the community does not cover? This helps the community make suitable offers.

supply_product.title: Tariff at {company}
supply_product.description: Choose your product or enter it.

feed_in.title: Feed-in
feed_in.description: Who buys the surplus electricity that is not used within the community? Leave empty if you have no generation system.

feed_in_product.title: Remuneration at {company}
feed_in_product.description: Choose your product or enter it.
